title: Page 4
content_zh:
她天生底子健康，所以病气刚转移到她身上时，她只有气弱，身子还没开始受到病气侵蚀，但过了半年多，她的身子已经明显虚弱许多，被病气一步步侵吞入骨了，恐怕再过不久，她就会变得像他之前一样，虚弱到连下床的力气都没有。
每每看到她虚弱的模样，他总觉得对她有所亏欠，为了弥补她，他只能想尽一切地对她好，这样他才会感到好过一些。
「那就到时候再说嘛。」宗雪莹天真地回道，一点都不明白事情的严重性。「至少我现在还可以来来去去，只要别太过分就好，如果连王也要管我，不让我来，我就一点乐趣都没有了。」
「来本王这里，能有什么乐趣可言？」兰霆不以为然地轻哼，他这里除了国事之外，还有什么？枯燥乏味，连他自己都觉得厌烦。
「当然有，看王总是气呼呼的模样很有趣。」她不怕死地回道。「我常在想，真的有那么多事情好气吗？想不透，真想不透……」
「……」他勉强地压抑下胸中怒火，要不是看在她是替他承厄的厄女，他绝对会把这个不知死活的野丫头给轰出去。
算了，就当自己多了一个黏人的妹子吧，他只能认了……
果不其然，又过了一个月，兰霆在御书房已经看不到宗雪莹的身影，因为她的身子已经禁不住一再偷溜的劳累，这一阵子都只能躺在床上休息，就算想下床也力不从心，就和他病得沈时一样。
他很明白，她现在是在替他受苦，他却无力阻止这一切发生，只能任由转厄咒继续生效，对她更是感到亏欠。
依她活泼的性子，此刻肯定感到非常苦闷吧……他没有多想，起身离开御书房，想过去看看她。
此时房里除了宗雪莹之外，还有伴着她的宗薰，从云渺山跟来的婢女朵儿则出去煎药，还没有回来。
「王，你怎么来了？」
坐在床上的宗雪莹讶异地看着兰霆，本以为他平常总是嫌她多话，现在她没力气去烦他，他会乐得清静，没想到……他居然还亲自来看她？
「本王爱去哪儿就去哪儿，你管得着吗？」兰霆没好气地瞪她，等太监将椅子搬到床旁，他才坐下。「这下子看你还想往哪里跑。」
「王来看我，我也不需要跑了呀。」宗雪莹原本有些困意，一看到他出现，笑得异常开心，精神都来了，抓住他的衣袖不放。「王，你这下子可是自投罗网，我有好多好多话想说，肯定烦死你。」
她感觉得出来，他是因为担心她才来的，虽然他总是没给她好脸色看，但其实他是很关心她的。
「莹儿，规矩一点。」宗薰皱眉提醒，真是拿永远学不会规矩的女儿没办法。
「不要紧，要是嫌烦，本王就不会过来了。」他轻勾起嘴角，终于露出微微笑意，幸好她虽然病得沈，却没有失去开朗，让他宽心不少。
「娘，是王说不要紧的，可不是我哦。」这下子宗雪莹更是有恃无恐，笑得可得意了。
宗薰无奈地摇摇头，既然兰霆都如此纵容女儿了，她还能说什么？

宗雪莹开心地对兰霆说了好多话，叽叽喳喳的，像是不知道该口渴似的，等到她说累了，终于敌不住困意睡着后，没想到，兰霆却还是没办法脱身。
因为她就连睡了，也紧抓着兰霆的衣袖不放，这让他想收回手却有所顾虑，就怕一惊动到她，她会马上苏醒过来，不肯再睡下。
宗薰赶紧替女儿道歉。「王，真的很抱歉，莹儿这样冒犯王……」
「罢了，等她睡熟，或许就会松开本王衣袖，本王就再多待一会儿。」兰霆早已拿她没奈何，对身旁的太监吩咐。「去御书房把本王还没看完的奏摺拿过来。」
「遵命。」太监马上转身离去。
他接着对宗薰说道：「你不必紧张地守在一旁，可以暂时去休息，一直在她身旁照顾，必定是件累人的事。」
「那我就暂时退下了。」宗薰微微一笑，知道兰霆是真心地关心宗雪莹，便放心地退出内房。
她打算在王宫陪伴莹儿一年，确定她的身子状况稳定之后，就回到云渺山去，虽然她在离山时暂时将族内事情交由下一任的族长继位者打理，但继位者还在学习当中，她不回去不行。
看到兰霆对莹儿的重视，她知道自己可以放心回云渺山，莹儿肯定会被照顾得很好，不必她担心。
宗薰退出后一段时间，太监也将奏摺拿过来，兰霆就坐在床边静静看起奏摺，好打发时间。
他本以为自己会巴不得她赶紧将手给松开，但事实却不然，他为她按捺下自己的脾气，有耐心地等着，一点都没有厌烦的感觉。
是已经被她给缠惯了吗？他感到有些好笑，堂堂的一国之王居然会被个小丫头给缠住，还拿她没奈何。
他原本还不甚专心，但在看到手上新的一本奏摺上所写的事情后，倒是轻蹙起眉头，仔细地审阅。
奏摺上写着，一向和兰凌国交情友好的狄国想以联姻方式加深两国关系，联姻的对象是狄国唯一的小公主，不过因为公主才八岁，希望能先订下婚约，等公主成年之后再举行婚礼。
他十四岁时继位，却只是个名义上的王，国事都交由母后处理，直到十五岁摆脱病厄，终于有精神处理国事，才开始上朝参与朝政，到现在也还不满一年，还是由母后辅政处理国事，所有奏摺都会先让母后在一旁提点意见，再由他做最后决定，而母后当然很赞同两国联姻之事，这对兰凌国只有好处没坏处。
他虽然明白两国联姻只关乎国家利益，无关情爱，但他就是厌恶这种被摆布的关系，只可惜他是一国之王，婚姻大事就是一笔只求最大利益的买卖，所以也只能应允婚事，没得选择。
将狄国联姻的奏摺放下，在所住的地方距离他有些远，所以他打算在他所住的寝殿旁边再建一座新殿阁，让她搬过去，他可以就近照顾。
看着工匠所画的新殿阁架构，兰霆微微勾起笑，并没有意识到自己此刻的笑容虽淡，却蕴含着他自己都没发现的柔情。
「王。」此时太监突然轻声说道：「宗姑娘松手了。」
兰霆回过神来，瞧向床上的人儿，宗雪莹果然睡得熟了，不知不觉便放开他的衣袖。

他将奏摺交给太监，想把她原本揪住他的那只手放进被里，免得受凉，但他才一将她小巧的手握住，她却下意识地回握着，像是在他的掌心里寻找温暖，熟睡的脸蛋更是漾起一抹舒服的笑意。
她微凉的体温竟像把热火，不经意地熨烫了他的掌心，教他不由得一愣，一种陌生的情感像是从两人交握处渗入他的肌肤，快速地窜入他的心口，渗进他的心里，根本猝不及防。
在他胸口荡漾着的陌生情绪，到底是什么？他困惑地轻蹙起眉，将她的手放进被里，然后抽回自己的手，看向什么都没有的掌心，无法理解。
此刻的他虽然还无法理解那一瞬间的微妙情绪到底意味什么，但他却早已将她给放在心上，对她呵护至极。
对她的怜爱之情，随着一日日的相处，益发深浓了……
第2章(1)
转眼之间，宗雪莹在兰凌王宫已经待上十年了。
content_en:
She was born with a healthy foundation, so when the disease energy first transferred to her, she only had weak energy and her body had not yet begun to be eroded by the disease energy. However, after more than half a year, her body was obviously much weaker, and the disease energy was eating into her bones step by step. I am afraid that before long, she will become like him before, so weak that she can't even get out of bed.
Every time he saw her weak appearance, he always felt that he owed her something. In order to make up for her, he could only try his best to be nice to her, so that he would feel better.
"Then we'll talk about it then." Zong Xueying replied innocently, not understanding the seriousness of the matter at all. "At least I can come and go now, as long as I don't go too far. If even the king wants to control me and doesn't let me come, I won't have any fun at all."
「来本王这里，能有什么乐趣可言？」兰霆不以为然地轻哼，他这里除了国事之外，还有什么？ It was boring and boring, even to himself.
「当然有，看王总是气呼呼的模样很有趣。」她不怕死地回道。 「我常在想，真的有那么多事情好气吗？想不透，真想不透……」
"..." He reluctantly suppressed the anger in his chest. If he hadn't seen that she was the misfortune girl who was responsible for him, he would definitely kick this wild girl out of the house.
算了，就当自己多了一个黏人的妹子吧，他只能认了……
Sure enough, another month later, Lan Ting could no longer see Zong Xueying in the imperial study, because her body could no longer bear the fatigue of sneaking away again and again. For a while, she could only lie in bed to rest. Even if she wanted to get out of bed, she couldn't do it, just like when he was seriously ill.
他很明白，她现在是在替他受苦，他却无力阻止这一切发生，只能任由转厄咒继续生效，对她更是感到亏欠。
依她活泼的性子，此刻肯定感到非常苦闷吧……他没有多想，起身离开御书房，想过去看看她。
At this time, in addition to Zong Xueying, there was Zong Xun accompanying her in the room. Duo'er, the maid who had followed from Yunmiao Mountain, had gone out to cook medicine and had not returned yet.
"King, why are you here?"
Zong Xueying, who was sitting on the bed, looked at Lan Ting in surprise. She thought he usually found her too talkative, but now that she didn't have the energy to bother him, he would be happy and peaceful. Unexpectedly... he actually came to see her in person?
「本王爱去哪儿就去哪儿，你管得着吗？」兰霆没好气地瞪她，等太监将椅子搬到床旁，他才坐下。 "Now let's see where you want to run."
"The king came to see me, I don't need to run away." Zong Xueying was a little sleepy at first, but when she saw him appearing, she smiled very happily and became energetic, grabbing his sleeve and holding on. 「王，你这下子可是自投罗网，我有好多好多话想说，肯定烦死你。」
她感觉得出来，他是因为担心她才来的，虽然他总是没给她好脸色看，但其实他是很关心她的。
「莹儿，规矩一点。」宗薰皱眉提醒，真是拿永远学不会规矩的女儿没办法。
"It doesn't matter, if it bothers me, I won't come here." He raised the corners of his mouth slightly and finally showed a slight smile. Fortunately, although she was seriously ill, she did not lose her cheerfulness, which made him feel relieved.
「娘，是王说不要紧的，可不是我哦。」这下子宗雪莹更是有恃无恐，笑得可得意了。
宗薰无奈地摇摇头，既然兰霆都如此纵容女儿了，她还能说什么？
Zong Xueying happily talked a lot to Lan Ting, chattering as if she didn't know when to be thirsty. When she said she was tired and finally fell asleep due to sleepiness, she didn't expect that Lan Ting still couldn't escape.
Because even when she was asleep, she still held on to Lan Ting's sleeve, which made him want to take his hand back but was hesitant because he was afraid that if he startled her, she would wake up immediately.Refuse to sleep anymore.
Zong Xun quickly apologized for his daughter. "Wang, I'm really sorry that Ying'er offended the king like this..."
"That's it. When she falls asleep, she may loosen my sleeves and I will stay a little longer." Lan Ting had already done nothing to her and ordered the eunuch beside him. "Go to the imperial study and bring over the memorial that I haven't read yet."
"As ordered." The eunuch immediately turned and left.
He then said to Zong Xun: "You don't have to stand by nervously. You can take a rest temporarily. It must be tiring to take care of her all the time."
"Then I will retreat for now." Zong Xun smiled slightly, knowing that Lan Ting sincerely cared about Zong Xueying, so he left the inner room with peace of mind.
She planned to stay with Yinger in the palace for a year, and then return to Yunmiao Mountain after making sure that her physical condition was stable. Although she temporarily left the affairs of the clan to the successor of the next clan leader when she left the mountain, the successor was still studying, so she could not go back.
Seeing how much Lan Ting valued Ying'er, she knew that she could return to Yunmiao Mountain with peace of mind. Ying'er would definitely be well taken care of and there was no need for her to worry.
Some time after Zong Xun withdrew, the eunuch also brought the memorial. Lan Ting sat by the bed and quietly read the memorial to pass the time.
He thought he would be eager for her to let go of her hand quickly, but that was not the case. He suppressed his temper for her and waited patiently, without feeling bored at all.
Are you already used to being pestered by her? He found it a little funny that the majestic king of a country would actually be entangled by a little girl and could do nothing to her.
He was not very attentive at first, but after seeing what was written on the new memorial in his hand, he frowned slightly and read it carefully.
The memorial stated that Di Guo, who had always been friendly with Lan Ling Guo, wanted to deepen the relationship between the two countries through marriage. The object of the marriage was Di Guo's only little princess. However, because the princess was only eight years old, they hoped to make a marriage contract first and wait until the princess came of age before holding the wedding.
He succeeded to the throne at the age of fourteen, but he was only a king in name only, and all state affairs were handled by his mother. It was not until he got over his illness at the age of fifteen that he finally had the energy to deal with state affairs, and then he began to participate in the government affairs. It is less than a year now, and his mother still assists in handling state affairs. In all memorials, the queen will first give her opinions and then he will make the final decision. Of course, the queen is in favor of the marriage between the two countries, which is only good for Lan Lingguo.
Although he understands that the marriage between the two countries is only about national interests and has nothing to do with love, he just hates this kind of manipulated relationship. Unfortunately, he is the king of a country, and marriage is a deal that only seeks the best interests, so he can only agree to the marriage and has no choice.
Putting down the memorial of Di Guo's marriage, the place where he lived was a bit far away from him, so he planned to build a new pavilion next to the dormitory where he lived so that she could move there and he could take care of her nearby.
Looking at the new palace structure painted by the craftsmen, Lan Ting smiled slightly, not realizing that although his smile was light at the moment, it contained a tenderness that he had not even noticed.
"King." At this time, the eunuch suddenly said softly: "Miss Zong let go."
Lan Ting came back to his senses and looked at the person on the bed. Zong Xueying was indeed fast asleep, and she let go of his sleeves without realizing it.
He handed the memorial to the eunuch and wanted to put her hand that was holding him under the quilt to avoid getting cold, but as soon as he held her small hand, she subconsciously held it back, as if looking for warmth in his palm, and a comfortable smile appeared on her sleeping face.
Her slightly cold body temperature was like a hot fire, ironing the palm of his hand inadvertently, making him stunned. A strange emotion seemed to seep into his skin from the place where the two of them met, quickly entering his heart, and seeping into his heart, completely caught off guard.
What is the strange emotion rippling in his chest? He frowned slightly in confusion and put her hand under the quilt., then withdrew his hand and looked at the empty palm, unable to understand.
Although he still couldn't understand what the subtle emotions at that moment meant, he had already taken her to heart and cared for her to the utmost.
The love and affection I feel for her becomes more and more intense as I get along with her day by day...
Chapter 2(1)
In the blink of an eye, Zong Xueying has been staying in Lanling Palace for ten years.
